chunks: I would leave them and go towards greenery and water.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali do during his period of quietude after the Ghadir?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) describes his practice during the period of relative quietude following the Battle of Jamal, where he would withdraw from the people and avoid political entanglements by seeking out places of greenery and water. This retreat, known as *al-Kala'*, reflects the Shia scholarly view of his strategic patience (*hilm*) and spiritual purification, distinguishing his stance from the active political maneuvering of his contemporaries while maintaining his legitimacy as Caliph.
